svg.text: Coupon Book · every other key screen, in flow order · same shell: navy bar, wallet tabs, carbon figures

exactly as it was left. Delete asks for confirmation.

front - VW Golf: 14 shared jobs (5 or more). Each is the
other's partner. 214 pick groups · 131 in the same aisle.
